Gabriela and her mother were born on the same day of the year. The table shows the relationship between g, Gabriela's age, and m, her mother's age.

Ages

| Gabriela’s Age, g | Her Mother’s Age, m |
|-------------------|--------------------|
| 3                 | 30                 |
| 5                 | 32                 |
| 9                 | 36                 |
| 10                | 37                 |

Which equation represents the relationship between g and m?
